Script.name: keydedup_main
Script.script:
-- =========================================================================== -- KeyDedup 3.7.1 - Mudlet Port -- Original author: Gizmmo (MUSHclient) -- Ported to Mudlet with DINV API & keyring replace all integration -- ===========================================================================
if type(keydedup) == "table" and type(keydedup.shutdown) == "function" then pcall(keydedup.shutdown) end keydedup = {} keydedup.version = "3.7.1" keydedup.scan_requested = false keydedup.batch_list = {}
-- ========= Helpers ========= local function trim(s) return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end local function strip_colors(s) s = tostring(s or "") s = s:gsub("@@", "\001") s = s:gsub("@x%d+", "") s = s:gsub("@.", "") s = s:gsub("\001", "@") return s end local function strip_ctrl(s) return (s:gsub("[%z\1-\31\127]", "")) end local function squeeze_spaces(s) return (s:gsub("%s+", " ")) end local function norm_name(s) s = s or "" s = strip_ctrl(s) s = strip_colors(s) s = squeeze_spaces(s) s = trim(s) return s:lower() end local function toint(s) local n = tonumber(s) return n and math.floor(n) or nil end
-- Store large IDs as strings to avoid Lua 5.1's %d overflow (max 2^31-1) -- Keyring IDs like 3669611946 exceed this and wrap to negative numbers with %d local function safe_id(s) local trimmed = (s or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if trimmed and trimmed ~= "" and tonumber(trimmed) then return trimmed -- keep as string end return nil end
-- Pretty print timer local function fmt_timer(sec) if sec == -1 then return "never" end local s = math.max(0, sec) local d = math.floor(s / 86400); s = s % 86400 local h = math.floor(s / 3600); s = s % 3600 local m = math.floor(s / 60); s = s % 60 return string.format("%dd %02d:%02d:%02d", d, h, m, s) end
-- Aardwolf @-color code to Mudlet cecho color name mapping local AARD_CECHO = { R = "ansiLightRed", r = "ansiRed", G = "ansiLightGreen", g = "ansiGreen", Y = "ansiLightYellow", y = "ansiYellow", B = "ansiLightBlue", b = "ansiBlue", M = "ansiLightMagenta", m = "ansiMagenta", C = "ansiLightCyan", c = "ansiCyan", W = "white", w = "ansi_white", x = "ansi_white", X = "ansi_white", D = "ansi_light_black", }
local function xterm_to_cecho(num) local n = tonumber(num) if not n or n < 0 or n > 255 then return "ansi_white" end if n < 16 then local basic = { [0] = "black", "ansi_red", "ansi_green", "ansi_yellow", "ansi_blue", "ansi_magenta", "ansi_cyan", "ansi_white", "ansi_light_black", "ansiLightRed", "ansiLightGreen", "ansiLightYellow", "ansiLightBlue", "ansiLightMagenta", "ansiLightCyan", "white" } return basic[n] or "ansi_white" elseif n >= 232 then local gray = 8 + (n - 232) * 10 return string.format("%d,%d,%d", gray, gray, gray) else local cube = n - 16 local b = (cube % 6) local g = math.floor(cube / 6) % 6 local r = math.floor(cube / 36) local levels = { [0] = 0, 95, 135, 175, 215, 255 } return string.format("%d,%d,%d", levels[r], levels[g], levels[b]) end end
-- ========= Color Output Helpers =========
local function print_row_colored(aard_name, name_w, timer_str) local output = "" local fg = "ansi_white" local i, n, vis = 1, #aard_name, 0
while i <= n do local ch = aard_name:sub(i, i) if ch == "@" and i < n then if aard_name:sub(i + 1, i + 1) == "@" then output = output .. "<" .. fg .. ">@" vis = vis + 1 i = i + 2 else local xterm = aard_name:match("^@x(%d+)", i) if xterm then fg = xterm_to_cecho(xterm) i = i + 2 + #xterm else local code = aard_name:sub(i + 1, i + 1) fg = AARD_CECHO[code] or fg i = i + 2 end end else local j = i while j <= n and aard_name:sub(j, j) ~= "@" do j = j + 1 end local seg = aard_name:sub(i, j - 1) if #seg > 0 then output = output .. "<" .. fg .. ">" .. seg vis = vis + #seg end i = j end end
local pad = name_w - vis if pad < 0 then pad = 0 end output = output .. "<ansi_white>" .. string.rep(" ", pad) .. " " .. string.format("%12s", timer_str) cecho(output .. "\n") end
local function show_deletion_report(rows) if #rows == 0 then cecho("\n<steel_blue>[keydedup] No duplicates found.\n") return end
table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a.nname == b.nname then if a.timer == b.timer then return a.id_num < b.id_num end return a.timer < b.timer end return a.nname < b.nname end)
local name_w = 9 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local plain = trim(squeeze_spaces(strip_colors(strip_ctrl(r.name or "")))) if #plain > name_w then name_w = #plain end end name_w = math.min(name_w, 70)
local hdr = string.format("%-" .. name_w .. "s %12s", "Key name", "Timer left") local sep = string.rep("-", #hdr)
cecho("\n") cecho("<black:gold>[ KeyDedup - destroyed duplicates ]\n") cecho("<yellow>" .. hdr .. "\n") cecho("<yellow>" .. sep .. "\n")
for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local t = (r.timer == -1) and "never" or fmt_timer(r.timer) print_row_colored(r.name or "", name_w, t) end
cecho("<yellow>" .. sep .. "\n") cecho("<ansi_white>" .. string.format("[keydedup] Removed %d duplicate key(s).", #rows) .. "\n") end
-- ========= Global Functions (called by triggers/aliases) =========
function keydedup_run() if not (DINV and DINV.api and type(DINV.api.getKeys) == "function") then cecho("\n<ansiLightRed>[keydedup] DINV API is required. Please ensure DINV is installed and loaded.\n") return end keydedup.scan_requested = true keydedup.batch_list = {} send("keyring replace all", false) send("echo KD_REPLACE_DONE") end
function keydedup_on_replace_done() if not keydedup.scan_requested then return end deleteLine() keydedup.scan_requested = false
if not (DINV and DINV.api and type(DINV.api.getKeys) == "function") then cecho("\n<ansiLightRed>[keydedup] DINV API is unavailable.\n") return end
local keyringResult = DINV.api.getKeys({ query = "location keyring" }) local invResult = DINV.api.getKeys({ query = "location inventory" })
local keyringKeys = {} if keyringResult and keyringResult.ok and keyringResult.items then for _, item in ipairs(keyringResult.items) do local nname = item.normalizedName or norm_name(item.name) if nname and nname ~= "" then keyringKeys[nname] = true end end end
local deletions = {} if invResult and invResult.ok and invResult.items then for _, item in ipairs(invResult.items) do local nname = item.normalizedName or norm_name(item.name) if nname and keyringKeys[nname] then deletions[#deletions + 1] = { id = tostring(item.id), id_num = tonumber(item.id) or 0, name = item.colorName or item.name, nname = nname, timer = tonumber(item.timer) or -1, } end end end
if #deletions == 0 then show_deletion_report({}) return end
-- Sort deletions by name, then timer, then id table.sort(deletions, function(a, b) if a.nname == b.nname then if a.timer == b.timer then return a.id_num < b.id_num end return a.timer < b.timer end return a.nname < b.nname end)
keydedup.batch_list = deletions
-- 1. Turn on the Gags (Prompts and Empty Lines) enableTrigger("KD_Gag_Prompt_Standard") enableTrigger("KD_Gag_Prompt_Tag") enableTrigger("KD_Gag_Empty")
-- 2. Send unkeep and destroy commands for duplicate keys in inventory for _, it in ipairs(deletions) do send("unkeep " .. it.id, false) send("destroy " .. it.id .. " inv confirm", false) end
-- 3. Send marker to finalize batch send("echo KD_BATCH_DONE") end
function keydedup_finalize_batch() deleteLine() -- Turn off the Gags disableTrigger("KD_Gag_Prompt_Standard") disableTrigger("KD_Gag_Prompt_Tag") disableTrigger("KD_Gag_Empty")
-- Show the table show_deletion_report(keydedup.batch_list) keydedup.batch_list = {} end
function keydedup_help() local w = 72 cecho("\n") cecho("<gold>" .. string.rep("=", w) .. "\n") cecho("<ansiLightCyan> KeyDedup v" .. keydedup.version .. " (Mudlet Port)\n") cecho("<gold>" .. string.rep("=", w) .. "\n") cecho("\n") cecho("<ansi_white> Deduplicates keys by replacing old keyring copies with fresh\n") cecho("<ansi_white> inventory keys via 'keyring replace all' and DINV API filtering,\n") cecho("<ansi_white> safely destroying extra copies that are already on your keyring.\n") cecho("\n") cecho("<gold> Usage:\n") cecho("<ansiLightCyan> kdedup <ansi_white>- Replaces old keyring keys and destroys remaining duplicates\n") cecho("<ansiLightCyan> kdedup help <ansi_white>- Shows this help message\n") cecho("\n") cecho("<gold> How it works:\n") cecho("<ansi_white> 1. Sends 'keyring replace all' to update and store fresh keys\n") cecho("<ansi_white> 2. Queries DINV API for keys on keyring vs in inventory\n") cecho("<ansi_white> 3. Identifies inventory keys that already exist on the keyring\n") cecho("<ansi_white> 4. Unkeeps and destroys duplicate inventory keys (non-keyringable keys are spared)\n") cecho("<ansi_white> 5. Displays a report of removed duplicate keys\n") cecho("\n") cecho("<gold>" .. string.rep("=", w) .. "\n") end
function keydedup.shutdown() keydedup.scan_requested = false keydedup.batch_list = {} if type(disableTrigger) == "function" then pcall(disableTrigger, "KD_Gag_Prompt_Standard") pcall(disableTrigger, "KD_Gag_Prompt_Tag") pcall(disableTrigger, "KD_Gag_Empty") end end
-- ========= Install Message ========= cecho("<ansiLightCyan>[<gold>KeyDedup<ansiLightCyan>] <ansi_white>v" .. keydedup.version .. " loaded. Type '<ansiLightYellow>kdedup<ansi_white>' to deduplicate or '<ansiLightYellow>kdedup help<ansi_white>' for info.\n")

Script.name: KeyDedupMCheckBridge
Script.script:
local function keydedup_mcheck_state_file() local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or "." local dir = home .. "/persistence" if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, dir) end if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, dir) end return dir .. "/mcheck_g_keydedup_path.lua" end
local function keydedup_mcheck_load_path() local ok, saved = pcall(dofile, keydedup_mcheck_state_file()) return ok and type(saved) == "string" and saved or "" end
local function keydedup_mcheck_save_path(path) local file = io.open(keydedup_mcheck_state_file(), "w") if not file then return end file:write("return " .. string.format("%q", path)) file:close() end
keydedup.mcheck = { protocol = "1", addon_id = "g_keydedup", package_name = "g_keydedup", repository_id = "noobgonewild-mudlet-scripts", filename = "g_keydedup.xml", source_path = keydedup_mcheck_load_path(), }
function KeyDedupMCheckBridge(event_name, ...) local args = {...} local metadata = type(keydedup) == "table" and keydedup.mcheck or nil if not metadata then return end if event_name == "mcheck.scan.request" then local scan_id, protocol, requested_addon_id = args[1], tostring(args[2] or ""), tostring(args[3] or "") if protocol ~= metadata.protocol then return end if requested_addon_id ~= "" and requested_addon_id ~= metadata.addon_id then return end raiseEvent("mcheck.scan.response", tostring(scan_id or ""), metadata.protocol, metadata.addon_id, metadata.package_name, keydedup.version, metadata.repository_id, metadata.filename, metadata.source_path or "") elseif event_name == "sysInstallPackage" then local package_name, source_path = tostring(args[1] or ""), tostring(args[2] or "") if package_name == metadata.package_name and source_path ~= "" then metadata.source_path = source_path keydedup_mcheck_save_path(source_path) end elseif event_name == "sysUninstallPackage" and tostring(args[1] or "") == metadata.package_name then if type(keydedup.shutdown) == "function" then pcall(keydedup.shutdown) end end end
